correctness.rationale: TARGET route: report claims direct disproof of admitted target's Azumaya-membership clause (audit-plan Step 2), which per audit plan fails the whole conjunction. Verified deductively, not experimentally. (1) X smooth: grad (4x^3,16y^3,-36z^3,-144w^3) vanishes only at origin in char 0, so smooth K3, integral (reducible hypersurface would be singular by product rule); theta in Q(X)^x since denominator not identically zero (witness P below). (2) K=Q(a), a^2=-2; x^2+2y^2=(x-ay)(x+ay), a^4=4. D+=X_K cap V(x-ay) is 8y^4-9z^4-36w^4=0 in P^2, smooth (grad 32y^3,-36z^3,-144w^3 only at origin), hence integral/geometrically irreducible (reducible smooth plane curve would have singular intersection), so prime divisor with K algebraically closed in k(D+). Transversality everywhere: dependence of grads forces z=w=0, then y=0 then x=0, invalid in P^3; so x-ay is uniformizer, v=1. (3) P=[a:1:zeta:0], zeta^4=8/9 in Kbar, lies on D+ since 4+4-9*(8/9)=0, with x+ay=2a!=0 and z^2+2w^2=zeta^2!=0, so neither factor vanishes identically; v_D+(theta)=1+0-0=1. (4) Tame symbol for (f,c) constant c in residue char !=2 is [c^{v(f)}]; here [-1]. (5) -1 not square in K: (u+av)^2=-1 gives uv=0, u^2-2v^2=-1, i.e. p^2+r^2=2q^2 with pq=0, impossible by sum-of-squares and 2-adic parity (v2(r^2) even vs v2(2q^2) odd); T^2+1 irreducible over K, and K alg. closed in k(D+) lifts to [-1]!=0 in k(D+)^x/squares. By purity Br(X_K)=intersection ker(residues), A not in Br(X_K), hence not in Br(X) via restriction. X_K integrality (geometrically integral smooth hypersurface) implicit but follows same argument. No gap, no boundary error. verify.py replays identities and prints VERIFY_OK (checked). Scope honestly limited to nominated representative.
